events.description:
Draft an email based on the following brief:

- Recipient: Design Team Lead
- Purpose: Requesting design review for mobile checkout flow
- Key Points to Cover: New checkout mocks are ready in Figma, review needed by Wednesday EOD, priority on payment step UX
- Desired Tone: friendly

Guidelines:
1. Write an appropriate subject line.
2. Ensure every single key point mentioned is addressed.
3. Structure the email logically with clear paragraphs.
4. Match the requested tone: friendly.
events.output:
Subject: Request for Design Review: Mobile Checkout Flow

Hi [Design Team Lead's Name],

I hope you're doing well. I'm reaching out to request your review of the new mobile checkout flow mocks that we've been working on. The designs are now ready in Figma, and I'd love to get your feedback before we move forward.

As you know, we've been focusing on improving the user experience, particularly on the payment step. I've made sure to prioritize this aspect in the new design, and I'd appreciate your input on how we can make it even more seamless for our users. Your expertise in UX design will be invaluable in helping us refine this critical step of the checkout process.

To ensure we meet our deadline, I'd like to request that you review the designs by the end of Wednesday. This will give us enough time to incorporate any changes and finalize the design before our next sprint.

If you have any questions or need any additional information, please don't hesitate to reach out. I've attached a link to the Figma file for your convenience.

Looking forward to hearing your thoughts on the new design.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
